page.content:
Zidane's 1998 hosts and later champions.

How France national team connects

  • Character: Zinedine Zidane — Zidane headed France to the 1998 World Cup on home soil.
  • Event: 2022 FIFA World Cup — France met Argentina in the 2022 World Cup final.

What is France national team?

France won the World Cup as hosts in 1998 with Zinedine Zidane, then again in 2018, a second-generation champion after the 2006 final heartbreak.

Key threads lead to Zinedine Zidane and 2022 FIFA World Cup.
